comment: Source registry for the real California PA graph. Adding a payer = add entries here + a parser module. Cadence is informational; fetches are manual/scheduled via the CLI.

sources.notes: Single PDF, updated monthly, carries its own effective date. Advanced imaging / spine surgery / pain management delegated to RadMD (Evolent/NIA); radiation + medical oncology delegated to CarePro. Delegate code lists are separate future sources.
Every IMR since 2001. This trend file does NOT name the health plan, so evidence is state-wide per treatment category, never per payer.

planned.notes: Integrated model; mostly referral-based rather than external PA.
